title: Transaction Fee Calculator (4 parts)
description_html:
Compute payment fees from a CSV of transactions. Each part unlocks after the previous one; about 45 minutes of coding.

Levels

  1. Part 1: fee by type
    • Each transaction type has a fixed fee plus a variable (percentage) fee
  2. Part 2: provider and country
    • The fee depends on the payment provider and the buyer's country: a fixed 30¢ plus a rate from a table
  3. Part 3: volume tiers
    • Once a merchant's total volume passes a threshold, later transactions use lower rates
  4. Part 4: disputes
    • If a merchant's dispute rate exceeds a threshold, an extra dispute fee applies

Constraints / rules

  • You write your own tests and edge cases.

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: Candidate-reported Stripe phone screen (Dec 2025 write-up). Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
